consequence.statement: Documentation-only change: removing the OLM installation and release docs has no operational effect on running installations; the evidence states nothing that stops working, and it does not state that OLM-based installation itself was removed.
consequence.remediation: Operators who install external-secrets via OLM should note the installation docs are no longer provided in the repository.

original.statement: The 0.16.0 release notes state that the OLM installation and release documentation was removed by PR #4617; this is a documentation-only removal with no stated change to any product surface.

decision.reason: The release note lists only the removal of the OLM installation and release docs [ev-2e2644c3f5f9]. The linked PR changed only two documentation files, docs/contributing/release.md and docs/introduction/getting-started.md, so this is a docs-only change that touches no runtime, chart or API surface [ev-36f654bce451]. The 'BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed' heading covers all 36 items, including dependabot bumps, so it does not mean this item breaks anything. "none" with an informational class fits: the evidence names nothing that fails, is rejected or must be migrated.
